The '''Aeneid system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained fifteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]], thirteen of which were inhabited. Each of the thirteen was represented on the [[Aeneid Council of Elders]]. According to the [[Sloogarian]] [[Squishmael]], a young [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was once tricked by [[Marshak]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] into smuggling [[Kessel (bird)|Kessel birds]] out of the Aeneid system.<ref name="Kessel Run" />
